engine_library.explanation: Total excludes the drug_supply extension (not in the published method). Published total lies inside the engine's P10-P90. Module allocation differs (initiation trips, storage) and the engine lacks hospital utilities and audits while assuming industry-level monitoring, so the module rows matter more than the total. Travel and freight now include direct and well-to-tank once; the former direct-only +5% result is obsolete. In the paper-factor variant, identified DESNZ 2022 combined factors are split into their documented components; the unidentified road factor is counted once with no extra WTT (its split remains unknown).
engine_library.label: Total
